/**
 * Complete business input used to exercise the PoA Step 3 schema compiler.
 * @schema https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
 * @title Complete PoA input
 * @additionalProperties false
 */
export interface InputParams {
  /**
   * City to process.
   * @minLength 1
   * @maxLength 120
   * @pattern ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .'-]*$
   */
  city?: string;

  /** Enables the optional processing stage. */
  enabled?: boolean;

  /** Demonstrates the JSON null type. */
  emptyValue?: null;

  /**
   * Retry count represented as a JSON Schema integer.
   * @minimum 0
   * @maximum 10
   * @multipleOf 1
   * @asType integer
   */
  attempts?: number;

  /**
   * Confidence must lie strictly between zero and one.
   * @exclusiveMinimum 0
   * @exclusiveMaximum 1
   */
  confidence?: number;

  /** A single literal becomes const. */
  kind?: "complete-example";

  /** A literal union becomes enum. */
  mode?: "fast" | "accurate" | "balanced";

  /**
   * Array syntax with all array constraints.
   * @minItems 1
   * @maxItems 5
   * @uniqueItems true
   */
  tags?: string[];

  /** Generic Array syntax. */
  scores?: Array<number>;

  /** A named interface becomes a $ref and a reachable $defs entry. */
  image?: ImageInput;

  /** A non-literal union becomes anyOf. */
  flexibleValue?: string | InlineObject;

  /**
   * Exactly one union branch must match: an HTTPS URL, or a 32-character hex report id.
   * The two patterns cannot both match one string, which is what `@oneOf` requires --
   * a value matching two branches is rejected just as loudly as one matching none.
   * @oneOf
   */
  exactValue?: HttpsUrl | ReportId;

  /** A same-base-type intersection is emitted as allOf. */
  boundedCode?: BoundedCode;

  /** Object intersections merge their properties and required fields. */
  combinedObject?: CombinedObject;

  /** Object explicitly allowing arbitrary values. */
  openMetadata?: OpenMetadata;

  /** Object whose extra values use an inline JSON Schema. */
  inlineMetadata?: InlineMetadata;

  /** Object whose extra values reference a named schema type. */
  namedMetadata?: NamedMetadata;

  /** A TypeScript string index signature also defines additionalProperties. */
  indexedMetadata?: IndexedMetadata;
}

interface ImageInput {
  type: "image";
  source: ImageBase64Source;

  /** @minLength 1 */
  name?: string;
}

interface ImageBase64Source {
  type: "base64";
  mediaType: "image/png" | "image/jpeg" | "image/webp" | "image/gif";

  /**
   * Base64 data without a data-URL prefix.
   * @minLength 1
   * @contentEncoding base64
   */
  data: string;
}

interface InlineObject {
  value: string;
}

/** The URL branch of the oneOf example.
 * @format uri
 * @pattern ^https://
 */
type HttpsUrl = string;

/** The identifier branch of the oneOf example. No string is both this and an https:// URL,
 * so exactly one branch can ever match. Note `@contentEncoding` would not do this job:
 * JSON Schema 2020-12 treats it as an annotation, so a `base64` branch matches every string
 * and swallows the other branch's values along with its own.
 * @pattern ^[0-9a-f]{32}$
 */
type ReportId = string;

/** @minLength 2 */
type AtLeastTwoCharacters = string;

/** @maxLength 8 */
type AtMostEightCharacters = string;

type BoundedCode = AtLeastTwoCharacters & AtMostEightCharacters;

interface RequiredPart {
  id: string;
  shared?: string;
}

interface OptionalPart {
  shared: string;
  note?: string;
}

type CombinedObject = RequiredPart & OptionalPart;

/** @additionalProperties true */
interface OpenMetadata {
  known?: string;
}

/** @additionalProperties {"type":"string","minLength":1} */
interface InlineMetadata {}

/** @minLength 1 */
type NonEmptyString = string;

/** @additionalProperties NonEmptyString */
interface NamedMetadata {}

interface IndexedMetadata {
  [key: string]: boolean;
}
